description: This file contains C source code implementing functions for setting up and managing display hardware components using DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) APIs. It includes functions to initialize connectors, encoders, CRTCs, planes, and resource cleanup related to display configuration on Amlogic devices.

methods.name: kms_setup_encoder
methods.description: Initializes the encoder within the kms_ctx structure by selecting an appropriate encoder from available resources based on matching IDs and CRTCs.

methods.name: kms_setup_connector
methods.description: Finds and sets up a connector with active modes and a connected status, assigning it to kms_ctx.

methods.name: kms_setup_crtc
methods.description: Sets up the CRTC (Cathode Ray Tube Controller) associated with the encoder if valid, updating the current display mode.

methods.name: kms_setup
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a kms_ctx structure, setting up connector, encoder, and CRTC resources.

methods.name: kms_cleanup_context
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a kms_ctx structure.

methods.name: kms_get_properties
methods.description: Retrieves the property ID by name for a given DRM object.

methods.name: kms_get_plane
methods.description: Finds primary and overlay planes available for the device and assigns their IDs to kms_ctx.
